capabilities: Paginate a note or all notes into sized pages with margins and page numbers in Reading view
Show a customizable formatting toolbar with headings, lists, tables, highlights, links, and images
Render linked mentions as cards with the linking passage at the foot of the page
Configure page size, margins, properties placement, and callout styling in settings
Let other plugins add their own buttons to the toolbar
extras: Runs on desktop with Obsidian 1.13.1 or later only; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; works entirely offline with no account.
problem: Obsidian shows notes as one continuous scroll, with no word-processor-style page layout, page breaks, or margins when reading or printing.

relations.evidence: With Home Cards installed, a Background button paints the space around your pages with any of Home Cards' patterns
Relate keeps its links in ordinary properties, so the notes that link here through Relate appear as labels
Style Settings lets you pick the colors of the sheets, the background, the cards and the page numbers
If you use Templater, Dataview, Tasks, Excalidraw, Longform, Linter, Citations, Pandoc or Better Export PDF

summary: Paginated reading view that lays notes out as A4 or Letter sheets with page numbers, a document toolbar, and linked mentions as cards.
